Name: Shay Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]This one was a request, and with permission from the original author JamesClawk, I've updated [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14260]Shay - New NPC[/url] for 1.6![/size]

[size=4]Shay is Shane's twin sister. She's a little worried about him, so she moves closer to him to support him![/size]

[size=4]Shay doesn't show up until you've seen Shane's six heart event, then head to Marnie's ranch afterward during the day to trigger Shay's intro events. [/size]

[size=4]After she's come to town, Shay will stay at the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30295]Pelican Valley Lofts[/url], in room 2H.[/size]

[size=4]Shay's sprites and portraits are originally from exrenkon's [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1946][size=4]Shane girl MOD[/size][/url][size=4], which has open permissions for use.[/size]

[size=4]She SHOULD be SVE compatible. I did test her with it and she seems to work fine but if you notice anything buggy, let me know.[/size]

[size=4]As of 1.2, Shay is now romanceable![/size]

[size=4]This mod requires SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Pelican Valley Loft.[/size]

[size=4][u]EVENT GUIDE[/u][/size]

[size=4]Intro 1 - View Shane's 6 heart event. Enter the ranch on a sunny day during business hours[/size]

[size=4]Intro 2 - go to bus stop between 6 am and 4 pm, Sun, Mon, Thu, Sat[/size]

[size=4]2 heart - go to beach on a sunny day between 7 pm and 11 pm. Bridge must be fixed[/size]

[size=4]4 heart - go to town between 6 pm and 11 pm[/size]

[size=4]6 heart - go to the forest on a sunny day between 8 am and 2 pm[/size]

[size=4]8 heart - go to farm between 4 pm and 10 pm[/size]

[size=4]10 heart - go to farm between 4 pm and 10 pm[/size]

[size=4]14 heart - go to town between 8 am and 5 pm on a sunny day[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
